## Backing Platform (Templateconnector Api)

- [Backing Platform (Templateconnector Api)](https://knuckles-team.github.io/templateconnector-api/platform/) — templateconnector-api is a client of a backing service instance. This page provides a Docker recipe for deploying one locally as an operator-selected provider endpoint.
